rules.authorized-target: (subjects.on.values.target = 'off' and subjects.on.values.level = 0) or (subjects.on.values.target = 'on' and subjects.on.values.level = 100 and subjects.`also.heater`.values.minLevel <= 100 and subjects.`also.heater`.values.maxLevel >= 100)
rules.climate-exhausted: (subjects.`also.vent`.values.reported = 'error' or subjects.`also.vent`.values.level >= subjects.`also.vent`.values.maxLevel) and (subjects.`also.fan`.values.reported = 'error' or subjects.`also.fan`.values.level >= subjects.`also.fan`.values.maxLevel)
rules.device-report: (fields.reported = 'error' and $length(fields.description) > 0) or (fields.description = '' and (((subjects.on.values.kind = 'vent') and fields.reported in ['open', 'closed']) or ((subjects.on.values.kind in ['fan', 'heater']) and fields.reported in ['on', 'off'])) and ((fields.reported in ['closed', 'off'] and fields.level = 0) or (fields.reported in ['open', 'on'] and fields.level >= 1 and (subjects.on.values.kind != 'heater' or fields.level = 100))))
rules.device-setup: fields.minLevel <= fields.maxLevel and ((((fields.kind = 'vent') and fields.target in ['open', 'closed']) or ((fields.kind in ['fan', 'heater']) and fields.target in ['on', 'off'])) and ((fields.target in ['closed', 'off'] and fields.level = 0) or (fields.target in ['open', 'on'] and fields.level >= 1 and fields.level >= fields.minLevel and fields.level <= fields.maxLevel and (fields.kind != 'heater' or fields.level = 100))))
rules.device-target: (((subjects.on.values.kind = 'vent') and fields.target in ['open', 'closed']) or ((subjects.on.values.kind in ['fan', 'heater']) and fields.target in ['on', 'off'])) and ((fields.target in ['closed', 'off'] and fields.level = 0) or (fields.target in ['open', 'on'] and fields.level >= 1 and fields.level >= subjects.on.values.minLevel and fields.level <= subjects.on.values.maxLevel and (subjects.on.values.kind != 'heater' or fields.level = 100)))
rules.probe-content: $exists(fields.moisture) or $exists(fields.ec) or $exists(fields.ph) or $exists(fields.height) or $exists(fields.insects) or ($length(fields.note) > 0 and $not($contains(" \t\r\n", $substring(fields.note, 0, 1))))
rules.zone-evidence: ($id := subjects.on.id; $z := fields.zones[zone = $id]; $lo := subjects.on.values.setpoint - subjects.on.values.band; $hi := subjects.on.values.setpoint + subjects.on.values.band; $count($z) = 1 and fields.min = $z.min and fields.max = $z.max and fields.mean = $z.mean and fields.inBand = $z.inBand and fields.min <= fields.mean and fields.mean <= fields.max and ((fields.min >= $lo and fields.max <= $hi) ? fields.inBand = 25 : ((fields.max < $lo or fields.min > $hi) ? fields.inBand = 0 : ((fields.min < $lo and fields.max > $hi) ? fields.inBand <= 23 : (fields.inBand >= 1 and fields.inBand <= 24)))))
rules.zone-order: subjects.on.refs.summary = null or (fields.sampledAt >= subjects.on.values.summaryTime and (fields.summary > subjects.on.refs.summary or (fields.summary = subjects.on.refs.summary and subjects.on.state = 'unobserved')))
